summary: A Victorian brick high-street terrace: three attached 13-wide shop-houses, each with its own steep slate front gable, a cream sandstone frame (piers, string course, cornice), a dark-oak fascia over an open shopfront (a deep and a shallow socket per house) and a door to a stair lobby beside it. The repeated gables and piers make it read as three houses that belong to one row, and the four material roles (walls, trim, fascia, roof) let each house be reskinned on its own.
concept_subject: A Victorian high-street terrace of three attached red-brick shop-houses on a cobbled street with a pale andesite pavement. Each house is 13 blocks wide, with two storeys of flats over a tall shop storey, and is topped by its own steep 45-degree grey-slate front gable, so the roofline forms a sawtooth of three matching gables that meet in valleys over the party walls. Cream sandstone piers stand one block proud and divide the houses; they run up to a strong sandstone cornice under each gable, and sandstone coping edges the verges. On the ground floor each house has a wide open shopfront under a dark-oak fascia board. The bookseller on the left has a blue awning and the lettering BOOKS, the florist in the middle has green and pink with FLORA, and the ironmonger on the right has red with TOOLS. Behind each open front sit spruce counters and glass fins. Every fascia has a hanging sign on a bracket and a lantern under its awning. A narrow brick bay beside each shop holds a dark-oak front door with a glass fanlight and a lantern on each side; this is the residents' door to the flats. Above a sandstone string course, each house has three recessed windows per floor, the centre one triple-width with a small iron Juliet balcony on the first floor, plus an attic window in the gable. Sills and lintels are sandstone, and the base course is grey stone brick. Behind the row, a brick chimney stack climbs each rear gable to above the ridge, with a stone band, a slab cap and white smoke. Small walled back yards of grass and paths lie behind.
concept_size: 39 wide (three houses of 13), 33 deep lot (18-deep buildings), shop storey + 2 flat storeys + gable loft, ridge at y 25
